title: Entity verification details
responsibility: Explains recorded coverage, test outcomes and media for one entity revision.

inputs.name: EntityTests.entity
inputs.description: Required entity with name, identifier, category and supplied verdict.

inputs.name: EntityTests.evidence
inputs.description: Required coverage, scenarios, records and media. After-side coverage judges the displayed revision; removed declarations are listed separately.

inputs.name: EntityTests.behavior
inputs.description: Required behavior results; nonempty rows render a behavior panel keyed to entity and commit.

inputs.name: EntityTests.mediaBase
inputs.description: Required base for recorded artifacts and media gallery.

inputs.name: EntityTests.exportHref
inputs.description: Optional record-download base, empty by default. A record and nonempty base produce a link with its record ID as query.

outputs.name: EntityTests
outputs.description: Verdict and reasons, scenario/state coverage and underlying check outcomes/durations, removed declarations, behavior and media. Missing records/scenarios remain explicit. Inapplicable states are labeled, and repeated slot reasons are suppressed when the state already says them.
